title: eunomia sagittata
intro: Eunomia sagittata, commonly known as the Arrow Head Flower or Eunomia, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eunomia sagittata include wound healing, anti-oxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
